response.sql:
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN e.`ANA Pattern` = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER BY avg_aCL_IgM DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Patients with no examination records qualify because none of their records has ANA Pattern 'S'; their average is NULL and sorts last.
